kind: Direct3D 8/9 scissor and device-state compatibility milestone

implementedOperations.ScissorRect: D3D9 SetScissorRect/GetScissorRect state reaches WebGPU dynamic scissor state; disabled draws retain the full render target
implementedOperations.SoftwareVertexProcessing: D3D9 mixed devices can switch the software-processing state while fixed hardware/software devices reject incompatible switches
implementedOperations.NPatchMode: disabled values succeed and unsupported tessellation values fail without aborting the guest
implementedOperations.RasterStatus: D3D8/9 return D3DERR_INVALIDCALL because browser scan-line status is unavailable and READ_SCANLINE is not advertised
implementedOperations.D3D8Forwarding: D3D8 raster status and software vertex-processing render state use the shared D3D9 device model

warmAssetCache.scope: guest assets and executable WASM only; JS modules, shader runtime, browser compilation and OS caches excluded

scope: This milestone adds reusable Direct3D 8/9 state and draw behavior and proves the original Humus executable still presents a recognizable WebGPU frame. It does not establish broad game compatibility.
